webhooks.detail: Xero has webhooks (HTTPS endpoint pushed change notifications) and a published xero-webhooks.yaml spec. Doc body text did not render, so the evidence is the pricing-table row, not a sentence.

sandbox.detail: Free Starter plan (No charge) and a free Xero demo company for development. The pricing table shows 'Demo org only' as a developer-tools row. The development-accounts page did not render.

rate_limits.summary: 60 calls/min and 5,000/day per tenant, 5 concurrent, 10,000/min per app; HTTP 429 on exceed

evidence.quote: If you exceed either rate limit you will receive an HTTP 429 (too many requests) response.
This SDK is one of a number of SDK’s that the Xero Developer team builds and maintains.
